zh: 空调坏了，我找人修好了。
old_en: The air conditioner broke, so I got it fixed.
new_en: The air conditioner broke, so I got it fixed.

zh: 天太热，他请人修了空调。
old_en: It was too hot, so he had the air conditioner fixed.
new_en: It was too hot, so he had the air conditioner fixed.

zh: 周末我请人打扫了房间。
old_en: On the weekend, I had my room cleaned.
new_en: On the weekend, I had my room cleaned.

zh: 搬家前，她找人打扫了一遍。
old_en: Before moving, she got her place cleaned.
new_en: Before moving, she had her place cleaned.

zh: 我请人剪了头发，看起来清爽多了。
old_en: I got my hair cut, and it looks much fresher.
new_en: I got my hair cut, and it looks much fresher.

zh: 她让人给她剪了头发。
old_en: She had someone cut her hair.
new_en: She had her hair cut.

zh: 电脑死机了，我让人修好了。
old_en: I had the computer fixed when it died on me.
new_en: The computer stopped working, so I had it fixed.

zh: 他请人修了电脑，花了不少钱。
old_en: He had the computer fixed and it cost a lot.
new_en: He had the computer fixed, and it cost a lot.

zh: 我把车送去洗车店洗了。
old_en: I got the car washed at a car wash on the weekend.
new_en: I took the car to a car wash to get it cleaned.

zh: 手表不走了，我拿去修了。
old_en: I had the broken watch fixed.
new_en: The watch stopped working, so I had it fixed.

zh: 周末他把车送去保养了。
old_en: He had his car fixed over the weekend.
new_en: He had his car serviced over the weekend.

zh: 家里没水了，我叫人送了一桶。
old_en: I had the water delivered because the tank was empty.
new_en: There was no water at home, so I had a bucket delivered.

zh: 他打电话叫人送水。
old_en: He had someone get water delivered.
new_en: He called someone to deliver water.

zh: 这份文件我请人翻译了。
old_en: I had the document translated.
new_en: I had the document translated.

zh: 合同太专业，他找人翻译了一遍。
old_en: He had the contract translated because it was too professional.
new_en: He had the contract translated because it was too complex.

zh: 我找人做了一个书架。
old_en: I got a bookshelf made for me.
new_en: I had a bookshelf made.

zh: 他把坏掉的表拿去修了。
old_en: He had the broken watch repaired.
new_en: He had the broken watch repaired.

zh: 新家找人装了窗帘。
old_en: She got the living room curtains installed.
new_en: They had curtains installed in the new home.

zh: 她请人装好了客厅的窗帘。
old_en: She had the living room curtains installed.
new_en: She had the living room curtains installed.

zh: 她请人做了一套木家具。
old_en: She had a set of wooden furniture made.
new_en: She had a set of wooden furniture made.
